evals.prompt: Initialize a ralph loop for my Python repo at ./test-repo with PRD.md, 3 workers, using Codex agent
evals.expected_output: Orchestrator creates runs/<initiative>/<run-id>/ directory with loop_state.json, workers.json, events.jsonl, and sets up git worktrees
expectations: The skill references ralph_orchestrator.py init command
The output includes --initiative flag as required
The output includes --agent codex or defaults to codex
The output mentions creating git worktrees for worker isolation
The output mentions creating an integration branch

evals.prompt: Run a full ralph loop from PRD to validated PR for my auth-overhaul initiative
evals.expected_output: Orchestrator runs all phases: init, plan, human checkpoint, run, review, report
expectations: The skill references the 'full' subcommand of ralph_orchestrator.py
The output mentions a human checkpoint before worker dispatch
The output mentions PR creation via gh
The output mentions validation gates (test, lint)
The output mentions RUN_RESULT.md generation

evals.prompt: Show me the status of my current ralph loop run
evals.expected_output: Orchestrator shows run status with worker cards, task progress, and PR status
expectations: The skill references the 'status' subcommand
The output mentions worker status/cards
The output mentions task completion counts
The output mentions the current round number

evals.prompt: Set up a ralph loop using OpenCode agent API instead of Codex
evals.expected_output: Orchestrator initializes with OpenCode as the agent backend
expectations: The skill mentions --agent opencode flag
The output references opencode run command or OpenCode API
Worker IDs use oc- prefix instead of codex-
The output mentions opencode_model configuration

evals.prompt: List all runs for my auth-overhaul initiative
evals.expected_output: Orchestrator lists runs under runs/auth-overhaul/ with status for each
expectations: The skill references the 'runs' subcommand
The output mentions --initiative flag for filtering
The output shows run IDs with their status
